statusReason: The AV Video application Rail is mounted, published and live-verified with the exact nine RAIL-1B slots, eight truthful Planned states, RAIL-2A breakpoints and device-local customization. Stream/Record and physical/operator acceptance remain open.
shipped: All six viewport candidates delivered across 20 routes: Calculator, shared navigation, 12 Show Operations tools, Cue Sheet, five Logistics tools and StagePlotter (#237–#243).
Four checks succeeded on each of PRs #237–#243; source deployment 37175190577 and AV destination deployment 37176560749 succeeded.
Published source.json and remote main agree on 1adc884 (checked 2026-10-04); live Calculator functional probes pass Chromium and WebKit.
AV Video owns its document and optional Patch, Checks, Backups and Displays/Projection modules; remaining Video capabilities follow the maintained plan.

The shared console workspace, Stage Slate first-use theme, offered draft recovery and device-local layout persistence shipped through #264 at 66b3d66; source deployment 37282446471 and AV deployment 37286283303 succeeded.
Console recovery hardening (#266): visible storage failures, guarded tab conflicts, cached geometry validation; pre-merge checks on Walter and live recovery checks on Duncan at 73a7bbe.

Cameras/Playback (#268, dependency repair #271): six legacy import families, ordered shots/cues, explicit route links, operator actions and reversible modules. Source/destination publication and isolated live acceptance verified at 338ea85 on Walter.

Application Rail (#279): AV Video now mounts the exact nine RAIL-1B console slots with eight non-actionable Planned entries, RAIL-2A phone/compact/labeled layouts, typed routes, device-local customization and offline assets. Source and AV publications succeeded; Walter live acceptance and seven-asset parity passed at 55bec1a.
